svg.title: meehaw live performer - key stickers (SHIFT layer large)
svg.text: meehaw live performer - key stickers (SHIFT layer large)
Print at 100 % (actual size, no 'fit to page'). The bar must measure 50 mm. Pitch 5.80 mm, sticker 5.00 mm, row gap 0.0 mm.
Large: SHIFT legend. Small: the main legend. Colours: track keys by category, parameter keys by their page colour (ui/palette.h), function keys grey.
Rows: y0 = set 1 tracks / Beat layers / rush / kick cut, y1 = set 2 (same), y2 = parameter + keys and functions, y3 = parameter - keys and functions; SHIFT = the space key (13,3).
Cut on the grey marks (one sticker per cell, 0.4 mm of white around each). The full map with every page is docs/KEYMAP.md; the manual is docs/MANUAL.md.
Generated 2026-10-16 by tools/make_stickers.py --pitch 5.8 --cap 5 --gap 0 (device: M5Stack Cardputer ADV, 56 keys 4 x 14, case 84.0 x 54.0 mm per M5Stack docs; the pitch is not
